'''2004 European Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament (2004). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 2004
